subject: maths
text_en: KS1 Number dimension targets: understand whole numbers and simple fractions; manipulate whole numbers and simple fractions; use simple properties of operations; formulate and solve simple problems involving numbers.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS2 Number dimension targets: understand different forms of numbers; interconvert forms; manipulate numbers and check reasonableness; use properties of operations; formulate and solve problems involving numbers.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS1 objectives: read/write/order numbers up to 5 digits and place value; addition/subtraction within 4 places (commutative/associative of addition); multiplication with 1-digit multiplier (multiplicand up to 3 digits) and division with 1-digit divisor; mixed operations with at most two operations; simple brackets in +/−; money coins/notes up to $1000 and price tags.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS1 fractions: understand and use fractions in everyday life; add/subtract fractions with the same denominator (answers not greater than 1; no simplification required).
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS2 fractions: proper/improper fractions, mixed numbers, equivalent fractions; +, −, ×, ÷ and simple mixed operations of simple fractions; reduce answers to simplest form; check by estimation; solve simple fraction problems.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS2 decimals: read/write/order decimals and place values; +, −, ×, ÷ and simple mixed operations up to two decimal places; rounding; percentages and conversions among decimals, fractions and percentages; simple practical problems on decimals and percentages.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS2 number extras: common multiples/factors, LCM and HCF of ≤3 numbers; squares/square roots of whole numbers; direct/inverse proportion via unitary method; average of a small everyday data set.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS1 Measures: mm/cm/m/km; perimeter of rectangles/squares; time (second, minute, hour, a.m./p.m.), calendar; compare lengths with standard units.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: KS2 Measures: metric relationships; area (cm², m²) and formulas for rectangles/squares; areas of parallelograms, triangles, trapeziums; approximate nature of measurement.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Annex I — Overview of Learning Targets and Objectives (KS1–KS2)

subject: maths
text_en: Ch.4 KS1 Number targets (summary): understand and manipulate whole numbers; understand simple fractions; examine reasonableness of results; formulate and solve simple problems involving numbers.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Ch.4 — Learning Targets of Key Stages 1 and 2

subject: maths
text_en: Ch.4 KS2 Number targets (summary): understand whole numbers, fractions, decimals, percentages and relations among them; manipulate numbers and examine reasonableness; formulate and solve problems involving numbers.
source: EDB Mathematics Curriculum Guide Ch.4 — Learning Targets of Key Stages 1 and 2

subject: maths
text_en: Word problems KS1: practical addition/subtraction/multiplication/division in everyday HK contexts (shopping, sharing, length/time/money). Prefer bare numeric answers for MC.
source: paraphrase: https://www.edb.gov.hk/attachment/en/curriculum-development/kla/ma/curr/annex%201.pdf

subject: maths
text_en: Word problems KS2: multi-step problems using four rules, fractions, decimals, percentages, unitary method for proportion; still primary-realistic (bus/ferry, school shopping).
source: paraphrase: https://www.edb.gov.hk/attachment/en/curriculum-development/kla/ma/curr/annex%201.pdf

subject: maths
text_en: Equal-sharing stem (IM Sharing Lunches): n people share m wholes equally → each gets m/n. Ask for a diagram, then write both addition (a/b+a/b+…=m) and multiplication (k×a/b=m) equations for the same situation.
text_zh: 平均分配題幹：n 人平分 m 個整體 → 每人 m/n。先畫圖，再用加法式與乘法式表示同一情境。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/5/B/3/tasks/2074

subject: maths
text_en: Fraction-as-division pattern: whole ÷ people = fraction share (e.g. 2÷3=2/3). Pair with 'of each whole' view (2×1/3=2/3). One stem, two equation forms.
text_zh: 分數即除法：整數÷人數＝每份分數（2÷3=2/3），並對應 2×1/3=2/3。同一題幹兩種算式。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/5/B/3/tasks/2074

subject: maths
text_en: Decimal place-value stem (IM How Many Tenths and Hundredths?): finish equations like '1 tenth + 4 hundredths = ___ hundredths' and '80 hundredths = ___ tenths'. Emphasise bundling and order of addends.
text_zh: 小數位值填空：1 tenth + 4 hundredths = ___ hundredths；80 hundredths = ___ tenths。強調單位換算與加數次序。
source: practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/4/C/6/tasks/103

subject: maths
text_en: Equivalent-fraction comparison stem (IM Running Laps style): compare distances like 1/4 mile and 3/12 mile; justify equality via common denominators or simplifying. MC or short reason.
text_zh: 等值分數比較：如 1/4 與 3/12 哩；用通分或約分說明相等。選擇或簡述理由。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/4/NF/A/tasks/971

subject: maths
text_en: Unlike-denominator addition pattern: rewrite with a common denominator before adding; keep answers in simplest form. Stem can be pure computation or a short story needing a/b + c/d.
text_zh: 異分母加法模式：先通分再加，答案約至最簡。可純計算或短應用題需 a/b+c/d。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/5/A/1/tasks/855

subject: maths
text_en: Fraction-of-a-quantity word-problem pattern: 'find a/b of N' (of operator). Prefer HK-flavoured everyday units (pages, dollars, minutes) but keep numbers small; ask for working.
text_zh: 求幾分之幾應用題：求 N 的 a/b。宜用日常單位（頁、元、分鐘），數字宜小，要求列式。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/5/B/3/tasks/2074

subject: maths
text_en: Decimal comparison/ordering pattern tied to tenths–hundredths: rewrite 0.6 and 0.62 as hundredths before comparing; warn that digit position matters (5 tenths+2 hundredths ≠ 5 hundredths+2 tenths).
text_zh: 小數比較／排序：先化成百分之一再比；提醒數位重要（5 tenths+2 hundredths ≠ 5 hundredths+2 tenths）。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/4/C/6/tasks/103

subject: maths
text_en: Multi-representation word-problem pattern: one everyday share/join situation → (1) diagram, (2) addition equation, (3) multiplication or division equation. Mark partial credit if only one form is correct.
text_zh: 多元表征應用題：同一分配／合併情境 → 圖示＋加法式＋乘／除法式。只對一種形式可給部分分。
source: paraphrase-practice: https://tasks.illustrativemathematics.org/content-standards/NF/5/B/3/tasks/2074

subject: maths
text_zh: 小一數：20 以內、100 以內的數（數數、讀寫、比較、單雙數、個位和十位）；先做 18 以內加減，再做最多兩位數的加減（須進位）；一步應用題。小一不學乘、除、分數。
text_en: P1 number: numbers to 20 then to 100 (count, read, write, order, odd/even, tens and units); addition and subtraction within 18 first, then two numbers of at most two digits with carrying; one-step problems. No ×, ÷ or fractions in P1.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 1N1–1N4

subject: maths
text_zh: 小一度量：直接比較長短、以厘米量度；認識香港硬幣、看價錢牌（整數元）；看鐘：整點和半點。
text_en: P1 measures: compare lengths directly and in cm; recognise HK coins and read price tags in whole dollars; tell time to the hour and half hour on an analog clock.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 1M1–1M4

subject: maths
text_zh: 小一圖形與空間：直觀認識柱體、錐體和球體；直線與曲線；三角形、四邊形、圓形；用上、下、左、右、前、後、中間描述位置。
text_en: P1 shapes and space: recognise prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres intuitively; straight lines and curves; triangles, quadrilaterals, circles; describe positions with over/under/left/right/in front of/behind/between.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 1S1–1S3

subject: maths
text_zh: 小二數：三位數、四位數，認識 > 和 <；最多三個三位數的加法（進位）及退位減法；乘法表（0–10）；乘法表範圍內的除法（包括餘數）；一步或兩步應用題。
text_en: P2 number: 3-digit and 4-digit numbers, > and <; addition of up to three numbers (≤3 digits, with carrying) and subtraction with borrowing; multiplication tables 0–10; basic division within the tables, including remainders; one- or two-step problems.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 2N1–2N6

subject: maths
text_zh: 小二度量與空間：米和厘米；看鐘至分鐘（指針鐘及數字鐘）；香港紙幣和硬幣、找續；立體的面；角（比較大小）；東南西北。
text_en: P2 measures and space: metres and centimetres; time to the nearest minute (analog and digital); HK notes and coins, giving change; faces of 3-D shapes; angles (compare sizes); east/south/west/north.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 2M1–2M3, 2S1–2S4

subject: maths
text_zh: 小三數：五位數；兩位數乘一位數、兩位數除以一位數；括號及四則混合計算（最多四個數）；兩步應用題。
text_en: P3 number: 5-digit numbers; 2-digit × 1-digit and 2-digit ÷ 1-digit; brackets and mixed operations (+ − with ×) of up to four numbers; two-step problems.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 3N1–3N4

subject: maths
text_zh: 小三分數（初步）：分數是一個整體或一組物件的部分；以圖像認識等值分數；比較同分母或同分子分數；同分母分數加減（結果不大於 1）。未學約分規則、假分數或小數。
text_en: P3 fractions (first contact): fractions as parts of one whole object or a set; equivalent fractions with concrete pictures; compare fractions with the same denominator or numerator; add/subtract same-denominator fractions with results not greater than 1. No simplifying rules, improper fractions or decimals yet.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 3N5

subject: maths
text_zh: 小三度量與空間：公里；秒；容量（升、毫升）；24 小時報時；重量（克、公斤）；平行線；直角、等腰、等邊及不等邊三角形；棒形圖。
text_en: P3 measures and space: kilometres; seconds; capacity (L, mL); 24-hour time; weight (g, kg); parallel lines; right-angled, isosceles, equilateral and scalene triangles; bar charts.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 3M1–3M5, 3S1–3S2, 3D1

subject: maths
text_zh: 小四數：兩位數乘法、除數是兩位數的除法；倍數和因數；以列舉法找公倍數和公因數；乘法分配律；整數多步應用題。
text_en: P4 number: multiplication and division by 2-digit numbers; multiples and factors; common multiples and common factors by listing; distributive property; multi-step problems with whole numbers.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 4N1–4N5

subject: maths
text_zh: 小四分數及小數：真分數、假分數、帶分數及互化；擴分、約分至最簡；比較同分母分數；認識小數是表示數的另一種形式（十分位、百分位）；一至兩位小數的加減。未學分數乘除、小數乘除；正式的小數與分數互化屬小六（6N2）。
text_en: P4 fractions and decimals: proper and improper fractions, mixed numbers and interconversion; expanding and reducing fractions to lowest terms; compare same-denominator fractions; decimals as another way to write numbers (tenths, hundredths); add/subtract decimals with 1–2 decimal places. No fraction × ÷ or decimal × ÷; formal decimal ↔ fraction interconversion is P6 (6N2).
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 4N6–4N8

subject: maths
text_zh: 小四面積：長方形和正方形的面積（長×闊；邊長×邊長），單位平方厘米（cm²）、平方米。認識周界與面積的分別。
text_en: P4 area: area of rectangles and squares (length×width; side×side), units cm² and m². Distinguish perimeter from area.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — P4 measures

subject: maths
text_zh: 小五分數：比較及加減最多三個異分母分數；分數乘法（包括整數）；分數作為商；分數除法；三個數的混合計算；答案以最簡分數表示。
text_en: P5 fractions: compare and add/subtract up to three fractions with different denominators; multiply fractions (and whole numbers); fractions as quotients; divide fractions; mixed operations of three numbers; answers in lowest terms.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 5N2–5N3, 5N5

subject: maths
text_zh: 小五小數：一個數乘以 10、100、1000 及 0.1、0.01；小數乘法。未學百分數。
text_en: P5 decimals: multiply a number by 10, 100, 1000 and by 0.1, 0.01; multiplication involving decimals. No percentages yet.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — unit 5N4

subject: maths
text_zh: 小五面積（三角形與四邊形）：認識三角形和四邊形的底和高；求平行四邊形、三角形、梯形的面積（公式：平行四邊形＝底×高；三角形＝底×高÷2；梯形＝（上底＋下底）×高÷2）。單位用平方厘米（cm²）或平方米。題幹以文字描述圖形及所給邊長／高，不依賴圖片。
text_en: P5 area (triangles and quadrilaterals): identify base and height of triangles and quadrilaterals; find areas of parallelograms, triangles and trapeziums (parallelogram = base×height; triangle = base×height÷2; trapezium = (a+b)×height÷2). Units cm² or m². Describe shapes and given dimensions in words — no diagrams.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 5M1 (area)

subject: maths
text_zh: 小五多邊形的面積：把不規則／複合多邊形分割（切開）成已知的三角形、平行四邊形、梯形或長方形，或用填補法補成較大的已知圖形再減去多出的部分，從而求面積。題幹用文字說明各部分的底、高或長闊（例如「一塊多邊形由一個底 8 厘米、高 5 厘米的平行四邊形和一個底 8 厘米、高 3 厘米的三角形拼成」），答案為數字，單位平方厘米。
text_en: P5 area of polygons: find the area of irregular/composite polygons by splitting (cutting) into known triangles, parallelograms, trapeziums or rectangles, or by filling/completing to a larger known shape and subtracting the extra. Describe each part's base, height or length/width in words (no diagrams). Numeric answers in cm².
source: EDB / HK primary P5 unit — area of polygons (composite via splitting/filling)

subject: maths
text_zh: 小五度量其餘部分：長方體體積；以符號代表數（簡易代數）。
text_en: P5 other measures: volume of cuboids; letters for numbers (simple algebra).
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 5M2, 5A1

subject: maths
text_zh: 小六小數：除以 10、100、1000 及 0.1、0.01；涉及小數的除法；分數與小數互化；化成小數比較分數大小；四捨五入至十分位／百分位。
text_en: P6 decimals: divide by 10, 100, 1000 and 0.1, 0.01; division involving decimals (decimal ÷ whole, whole ÷ decimal, decimal ÷ decimal); interconvert fractions and decimals; compare fractions via decimals; round to tenths/hundredths.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 6N1–6N2

subject: maths
text_zh: 小六百分數：認識百分數；百分數與分數、小數互化；求一個數的百分之幾、甲是乙的百分之幾、增加／減少百分之幾（折扣）；平均數；圓與圓周率。
text_en: P6 percentages: meaning of %; convert between percentages, fractions and decimals; find a percentage of a quantity, what percentage one number is of another, increase/decrease by a percentage (discounts); averages; circles and π.
source: EDB Supplement: Learning Content of Primary Mathematics (2017) — units 6N3–6N4, 6D1, 6M3
